peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (94.2): 6.3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 380 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Initial resale-wave effect: 2 of the 4 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Aug 2025–Jul 2026), so this figure is not yet a sustained rate; sustained activity remains settling. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 26.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave

lines.statement: Settling: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave, so sustained activity is not yet measurable. Observed activity is shown. First resale wave from Aug 2025 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 1 earlier resale does not start the wave. 2 months available from Aug 2026; measurable with data to Jul 2027. Observed: 6.3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months).

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Somerset MRT about 530 m, Great World MRT about 560 m; closer than 165 of 551 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest River Valley Primary School about 330 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 9 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 230 m), more than 419 of 551 similar developments (the same as 42); nearest hawker centre Kukoh 21 Food Centre about 800 m; nearest park Jubilee Park (Fcp) about 650 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Hill House, 5 new sales, about 120 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 230 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 480 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 490 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 600 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 730 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 760 m; Canninghill Piers, 8 new sales, about 830 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 323 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,451 new sales and 1,102 resales (2,553 purchases); new sales were 56.8% of these purchases. Subsales (45) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,102 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 347 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,102 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,246 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−11.6%). Planning-area private resales −3.8%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
